title: Piping protection.
officialText:
Proper allowance shall be made for expansion, contraction, jarring and vibration. Piping other than tubing,
connected to underground tanks, except straight fill lines and test wells, shall be arranged to permit the tanks to settle without impairing
the tightness of the piping connections. Piping serving equipment at levels above the lowest floor or storage tanks at levels above the
lowest floor in buildings shall also comply with the requirements of Sections 1305.9.6 and 1305.9.7.
SECTION MC 1304
PIPING SUPPORT
